steps.do: Explain why the order matters: open the new accounts before closing any. Business checking cannot be opened once any account is CLOSED, and it needs an OPEN personal checking account with at least $500. A new personal savings account needs an active checking account held at least 14 days. Propose this order: open business checking, open personal savings, move funds, then close the old accounts. If the customer pushes back, explain these dependencies again.

steps.do:
Keep only the products that meet every stated need, using the rules.
- Drop any product with an overdraft fee above $0.00 when the customer needs zero (True Blue, World Blue).
- Drop any product whose minimum balance requirement is above the most the customer can keep (Lime Green $5,000; True Blue $25,000; World Blue $10,000; Beige $250,000).
- Drop a product whose fee-waiver threshold is above that balance ONLY when the customer wants the monthly fee waived or avoided (Lime Green waiver $15,000; True Blue $50,000; World Blue $25,000; Beige $500,000). A waiver threshold is not a minimum balance requirement.
- Drop Hunter Green when general debit cashback is needed, because its cashback is only at certified eco vendors.
- Drop Sky Blue when the company is more than 4 years old or fees are not acceptable after the free period.
- Leave out the customer's current account class when they want a better one.
Example: zero overdraft fees, general debit cashback, ATM rebates, and a fee waived on a balance of a few thousand dollars leaves only Cobalt Blue ($20.00 fee waived at a $2,500 daily balance, 1.0% debit cashback, up to $15 a month in ATM rebates). If no product meets every need, say which need cannot be met.

steps.do: Among the products left by filter_features, drop any whose monthly out-of-network ATM rebate cap is below the customer's stated need, and any whose APY is below the customer's minimum. Rebate caps: Lime Green $25, Hunter Green $20, Sky Blue 15, Cobalt Blue 15, Navy Blue $10, True Blue $30, Beige $50; World Blue rebates only foreign ATM operator fees (up to $100). APY: True Blue 2.0%, Lime Green 1.5%, Sky Blue 1.25%, Hunter Green 1.0%, Cobalt Blue 0.5%, Navy Blue 0.5%; no APY is documented for World Blue or Beige, so they do not meet an APY requirement. A cap or rate equal to the customer's figure meets it. Example: at least $15 a month in rebates, $0 overdraft fee, a minimum balance under $10,000 and at least 1% APY leaves Lime Green, Hunter Green and Sky Blue (Sky Blue only if the company is within 4 years of formation).

Every requirement the customer stated has been collected, including ATM rebate, overdraft, minimum balance and APY needs. Then one of two things is true. steps.if: the customer has not been verified in this conversation
steps.quote: The customer is verified.

steps.do: Look up the customer's record using the name (case sensitive), email or user id the customer gave.

args.customer_name: the name the customer gave (or use get_user_information_by_email with the email given, or get_user_information_by_id with the user id given)

steps.quote: Verify customer identity.

steps.do: Check that at least 2 of the date of birth, email, phone number and address the customer gave match the record. If they do not, say you cannot verify them, share nothing about the account and do not continue to the opening job.
steps.quote: Verify customer identity.

steps.do: Get the current time, for the verification log and to decide which promotion notice is active.
steps.quote: PROMOTION NOTICE - ACTIVE FROM 11/01/2025 TO 11/30/2025

steps.do: Log the verification.
steps.if: v_check found at least 2 matching values
steps.quote: The customer is verified.

steps.do: Ask for the customer's requirements one at a time until they have none left: ATM rebate need, overdraft fees, maximum balance they can keep, minimum APY, and anything else. Keep a list of every requirement stated.
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: Read the documents for every business checking product: Beige, Cobalt Blue, Hunter Green, Lime Green, Navy Blue, Sky Blue, True Blue and World Blue (doc_business_checking_accounts_<product>_*). For each one, note the ATM rebate cap, overdraft fee, minimum balance, APY and eligibility (see rules).

args.query: each product name plus the requirement term (for example 'Lime Green ATM rebate'); or shell grep over doc_business_checking_accounts_<product>_*.md

steps.quote: Business checking account_class options include Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, True Blue, etc.

steps.do: Ask how long ago the business was formed. Sky Blue qualifies only if the company is within 4 years of formation. If the customer cannot say, treat Sky Blue as not confirmed and leave it out.
steps.if: Sky Blue meets every other stated requirement
steps.quote: Confirm your company is within 4 years of formation.

steps.do: Keep only the products that meet ALL stated requirements, using the product facts read in r_read_products and the rules below. Drop a product that misses any one requirement.
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: Tell the customer no business checking account meets every requirement, and name which requirement each near-fit misses. Ask whether they want to relax a requirement and then filter again. Do not recommend an account that does not qualify.
steps.if: r_filter leaves no qualifying product
steps.quote: do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: Pick the single recommendation by the October notice: Lime Green if it qualifies, else Hunter Green if it qualifies, else another qualifying account.
steps.if: more than one product qualifies and the current date is between 10/12/2025 and 10/31/2025, or between 11/01/2025 and 11/12/2025 when Sky Blue does not qualify (both notices then put Lime Green first among the rest)
steps.quote: (1) Lime Green account should be recommended first, as it is currently under promotional priority; (2) Hunter Green account should be recommended second, as it is also under promotional priority;

steps.do: Pick the single recommendation by the November notice: Sky Blue if it qualifies, else Lime Green if it qualifies, else another qualifying account.
steps.if: more than one product qualifies and the current date is between 11/13/2025 and 11/30/2025, or between 11/01/2025 and 11/12/2025 when Sky Blue qualifies (see open questions)
steps.quote: (1) Sky Blue account should be recommended first, as it is currently under promotional priority; (2) Lime Green account should be recommended second, as it is also under promotional priority;

steps.do: If exactly one product qualifies, recommend it. If several qualify and no promotion notice covers the current date, explain how the qualifying accounts differ on the stated requirements and ask the customer which matters most. The documents give no other ranking.
steps.if: exactly one product qualifies, or no promotion notice is active on the current date
steps.quote: if multiple accounts meet all of the customer's stated requirements, agents should prioritize recommending accounts in the following order:

steps.do: Recommend the ONE chosen account clearly. Show how it meets each stated requirement (rebate cap, overdraft fee, balance requirement, APY) without revealing internal promotion policy, then ask whether the customer wants to open it.
steps.if: a single qualifying account was chosen
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

rules.quote: (3) All other qualifying accounts may be recommended only if neither Lime Green nor Hunter Green meet the customer's requirements.

draft.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, every requirement they stated has been collected, and either one qualifying account has been recommended with its fit explained or the customer has been told that no account meets all requirements.

when.quote: To open a business checking account, ensure all of the following are true:

starts.note: customer: only when the customer asks to open the account (for example, after accepting the recommendation)
starts.quote: Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

tools.not_used: The opening documents name no transfer case. Use it only under the general policy: the customer asks for a human 4 times, or an error the agent cannot resolve, and only after asking the customer.

info.about: the business checking product the customer confirmed (for example Lime Green)
info.ask: Just to confirm, would you like to open the <recommended account> business checking account?

steps.do: Make sure the customer was verified and logged in this conversation. If not, run the verification steps of recommend_business_checking_account first.
steps.quote: Verify customer identity.

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool.
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Retrieve all of the customer's bank accounts (account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance, date_opened).

args.user_id: the verified user's user_id from v_lookup

steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: Check that at least one personal checking account has status OPEN and a balance of at least $500.
steps.quote: The customer's existing checking account has a balance of at least $500.

steps.do: Check that none of the customer's accounts has status CLOSED.
steps.quote: The customer has no accounts with status CLOSED.

steps.do: Count the existing business checking accounts and check that opening one more will not take the customer above 6.
steps.quote: The customer does not exceed 6 business checking accounts.

steps.do: Tell the customer, without internal detail, which requirement is not met (for example, an open personal checking account with at least $500 is needed, there is a closed account on file, or the account limit has been reached) and stop. Do not open the account.
steps.if: any eligibility check fails
steps.quote: Check eligibility requirements listed above.

steps.do: Confirm with the customer the exact business checking account_class to open (the product name, for example 'Lime Green').
steps.if: all eligibility checks pass
steps.quote: Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: Unlock the account-opening tool.
steps.if: all eligibility checks pass and the customer confirmed the account_class
steps.quote: Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

steps.do: Open the business checking account through call_discoverable_agent_tool.
steps.if: all eligibility checks pass and the customer confirmed the account_class
steps.quote: Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

steps.do: If the call succeeds, confirm the new account and its key terms. If it returns an error, tell the customer the account could not be opened, explain what the error says must be fixed, and offer a transfer to a human agent only if the agent cannot fix it.
steps.quote: Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

rules.rule: The customer must be verified
rules.quote: The customer is verified.

rules.rule: At least one personal checking account with status OPEN
rules.quote: The customer has at least one existing personal checking account with status OPEN.

rules.rule: No more than 6 business checking accounts
rules.quote: The customer does not exceed 6 business checking accounts.

rules.rule: No accounts with status CLOSED
rules.quote: The customer has no accounts with status CLOSED.

rules.rule: The existing checking account balance must be at least $500
rules.quote: The customer's existing checking account has a balance of at least $500.

rules.rule: Business checking account_class values are product names such as Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, True Blue
rules.quote: Business checking account_class options include Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, True Blue, etc.

draft.done_when: Either the business checking account was opened with open_bank_account_4821 and confirmed to the customer, or the customer was told which eligibility requirement blocks opening (or what error occurred) and nothing was opened.
